name: Chocolate
source: When the protagonist meets her, her name is Chocolate.  When she 'evolves' near the end of the game her name is [url=/c114203]Sachertorte[/url].  She is the wealthy grand-daughter of the president of the school where the protagonist is employed as a nurse.  Her hobby is enjoying afternoon tea.  She hates people who order her around.  Her dream is world domination.
